answer: A bond-backed registry resists sybils: each agent posts a stake that is slashed when fraud is proven, so a farm pays a real price for every clone, like a comet that burns only while it has fuel to spend. The failure mode is a wealthy attacker buying many bonds at once, so the required stake grows with the horizon of privileges an identity claims. The check is a public audit: a beacon jury re-verifies a random sample of claimed work each epoch, and any identity whose stake rests on fabricated history loses the bond and its eligibility.
